summary: ubuntu-noble (Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS) fails 98 SCA checks in cis_ubuntu24-04 (score 51%). These 5 fixes come first, ranked by remote exposure, authentication and privilege impact. Start with: Ensure iptables-persistent is not installed with ufw.

fixes.title: Ensure iptables-persistent is not installed with ufw
fixes.why: Running both ufw and the services included in the iptables-persistent package may lead to conflict.
fixes.remediation: Run the following command to remove the iptables-persistent package: # apt purge iptables-persistent.
evidence: SCA check 35621 failed in policy cis_ubuntu24-04

fixes.title: Ensure ufw default deny firewall policy
fixes.why: With a default accept policy the firewall will accept any packet that is not configured to be denied. It is easier to allow list acceptable usage than to deny list unacceptable usage.
fixes.remediation: Run the following commands to implement a default deny policy: # ufw default deny incoming # ufw default deny outgoing # ufw default deny routed.
evidence: SCA check 35624 failed in policy cis_ubuntu24-04

fixes.title: Ensure nftables is not in use with iptables
fixes.why: Running both iptables and nftables may lead to conflict.
fixes.remediation: Run the following command to remove nftables: # apt purge nftables - OR - Run the following commands to stop and mask nftables.service: # systemctl stop nftables.service # systemctl mask nftables.service.
evidence: SCA check 35634 failed in policy cis_ubuntu24-04

fixes.title: Ensure ufw is not in use with iptables
fixes.why: Running iptables.persistent with ufw enabled may lead to conflict and unexpected results.
fixes.remediation: Run the following command to remove ufw: # apt purge ufw - OR - Run the following commands to disable ufw, and stop and mask ufw.service: # ufw disable # systemctl stop ufw.service # systemctl mask ufw.service Note: ufw disable needs to be run before systemctl mask ufw.service in order to correctly disable UFW.
evidence: SCA check 35635 failed in policy cis_ubuntu24-04

fixes.title: Ensure permissions on /etc/ssh/sshd_config are configured
fixes.why: configuration specifications for sshd need to be protected from unauthorized changes by non-privileged users.

evidence: SCA check 35640 failed in policy cis_ubuntu24-04
